description:
Desktop AI agent with plugins, an embedded browser, workspace files, and local model support.

Lexora is a personal AI agent that evolves through hands-on work on your desktop. Beyond coding, it helps you organize research, refine creative projects, and plan everyday activities. Tell it what you want to accomplish, and it keeps working toward that goal, making words the starting point for work, creativity, and everyday life.
This release focuses on making everyday use smoother, clearer, and less disruptive. From starting the app and sending messages to reading replies aloud, generating images, and switching views, these refinements reduce unnecessary waiting and repeated checks so you can stay focused on your task.
Agents can now ask you questions within a task when they need information or a decision, collecting your answers through choices or text. Browser operations also have separate execution pages that open in the background by default, reducing interruptions to what you are viewing.
You can also choose between Stable and Beta update channels and adjust tool invocation to suit your model, adding flexibility to your familiar workflow.
